static_traits.name: Li Mingjie
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and a younger sibling
static_traits.social_status: Family support exists, but Relationship tension with friends and family; tending toward self-isolation when emotions are triggered
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness, has not yet received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Hesitant expression, often using negating self-evaluations and vague statements (e.g. 'I do not know'/'hard to describe'); cooperative but skeptical; tending to downplay positive feedback

basic_info.main_problem: I have long felt 'not good enough' or 'not worthy of success', worsening in recent months; when achieving something or being praised I doubt my achievements, feeling unworthy of any recognition; pressure and self-expectations have developed the problem into doubting achievements.
basic_info.core_demands: These not-good-enough feelings are affecting my motivation, self-esteem and overall mental health; I need help to deal with and overcome these negative thoughts.
growth_experiences: The inner experience of 'I am not good enough/not worthy of success' has persisted since childhood, markedly worsening in recent months under Academic pressure and heightened self-expectations; especially prone to triggering Self-doubt and negation when achieving something or being praised by others.

During past Academic pressure periods, coped by 'working harder, setting higher goals'; although it temporarily boosted performance, it also reinforced the cognitive and behavioral pattern of evaluating oneself with harsh standards and negating when not yet reaching them.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of success

special_situations.event: When making concrete progress (such as continuously saving for the dream Porsche and making obvious progress)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If 'anyone can do this', it does not count as a real achievement
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Maintaining a cautious evaluation of self-worth by belittling or negating my own achievements
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This does not count as ability; anyone can do it

special_situations.event: When receiving others' praise or positive feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not perfect or have not put in enough, no praise counts
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplaying others' affirmation, emphasizing my inadequacies to avoid being seen through
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being polite and do not know how little I actually put in

special_situations.event: When comparing grades or achievements with peers or others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only being better than others deserves recognition; not being the best equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly raising goals, pressuring myself and frequently comparing with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My achievements are meaningless; others are all stronger

special_situations.event: When not yet reaching self-set high standards or encountering Academic pressure periods
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Not reaching high expectations proves I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Working desperately hard, setting higher goals to make up for not being good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be genuinely seen and recognized, feeling oneself worthy of success and praise
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated or exposed as 'unworthy/impostor', fearing humiliation after exposing inadequacy
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being exposed by negating or downplaying achievements
Keeping distance from others to avoid being evaluated or burdening family
Demands more of himself with higher standards to gain a sense of control and safety

object_relations.self_representation: A 'doubted person/impostor' not good enough, unworthy of success
object_relations.object_representation: The outside world consists of harsh judges or superficially friendly people who do not truly understand me

object_relations.self_representation: A Withdrawal person who burdens loved ones
object_relations.object_representation: Family are people I would drag down, from whom I need to hide problems

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others invite reviewing achievements and give positive affirmation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing the other party is just being polite or does not understand the real effort (transference: experiencing others as uncomprehending judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing 'this is nothing' in a flat, restrained tone, highlighting my inadequacies and how little I put in, downplaying others' affirmation with Interpretation.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked to try new self-affirmation exercises or face the possibility of positive change
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing change as almost impossible, worrying about being proven unworthy (transference: experiencing the counselor's encouragement as pressure)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a hesitant and doubtful tone, frequently expressing 'not sure it is useful', avoiding the emotional impact of exercises through procrastination and lowered expectations.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about comparing with others or Academic pressure topics
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing others as superior threateners, convinced I am surely not as good as others (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Quickly asserts 'they are all better' with declarative sentences, reducing self-exploration, avoiding discussion of own efforts and strengths.

manifestations: Still believing 'meaningless/does not count' when achieving something or being praised
After frequent comparisons with others, feels a lack of self-worth
Avoids communicating with family and friends to avoid 'adding burden to the family'
Choosing self-isolation when emotions are triggered
outcomes: Increased subjective sense of pressure, increased helplessness

contact_model.definition: The individual has unhealthy self-Reflection and excessive self-restriction, self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Excessively compares with others and demands higher standards of oneself
Difficulty accepting praise and positive feedback

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Interpreting others' praise as 'just being polite' or 'not understanding me'
Inferring others' motives as false or inaccurate

contact_model.definition: The individual turns the energy of the original desire directed outward toward himself, or gives up seeking others to do something for him outwardly.
manifestations: Not confiding in family on the grounds of 'not troubling others'
Choosing to bear it alone rather than seek support when emotions are triggered

exception_events.target_problem: When making progress or receiving praise, the client usually belittles their achievements, developing thoughts of 'I am not worthy/not good enough', then Decreased drive and distancing from others.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In the past few months, has persistently made and carried out a savings plan for the Porsche of his dreams, depositing according to the plan and making clear progress; in this process he maintained engagement and self-management.
exception_events.reason: Clue: set clear and quantifiable goals and plans; the task had visible phased results; the home environment was stable and the pace controllable, enabling sustained action and visible positive feedback, so this performance was different.

positive_force: Able to set goals and advance through sustained action (savings plan making progress)
Family support exists; has support resources available to use
Having some self-awareness, able to identify the 'belittling the positive' thought pattern
negative_force: Excessive self-comparison, often judges oneself by others' standards
High standards and perfectionist tendencies, Self-denial when not yet reaching them
Finding it hard to accept praise, tending to negate positive feedback
Avoiding family and friends due to shame and Self-doubt, leading to Relationship tension and Loneliness
Irregular sleep and reduced interests, further weakening Learning motivation

target_behavior.behavior: Automatic thoughts and speech negating and belittling one's own achievements
antecedent: Has made phased progress toward goals (such as results in saving money)
target_behavior.core_reason: Core belief 'I am not good enough/not worthy of success', and worrying about being exposed as an 'impostor'
target_behavior.function: Avoiding being judged and exposing imperfection, maintaining Self-protection's low expectations
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased drive, Impaired self-esteem, Low mood, further affecting academics and relationships

antecedent: Not yet reaching self-set high standards
target_behavior.core_reason: Viewing not yet reaching goals as 'total failure', triggering avoidance and exhaustion
target_behavior.function: Briefly avoiding Demands and failure feelings, easing immediate Anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance/distancing from family and friends
antecedent: Triggering self-evaluation of 'not good enough/not worthy'
target_behavior.core_reason: Shame and Self-doubt, worrying others will see the real inadequacies
target_behavior.function: Avoids being evaluated and emotional exposure, maintaining surface safety
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship tension, reinforced sense of Loneliness, Weakened support system

antecedent: Ongoing Academic pressure and active Negative self-evaluation
target_behavior.core_reason: Low mood and cognitive load leading to disrupted routines and Anhedonia
target_behavior.function: Short-term avoidance of stress and tasks (such as procrastination, staying up late)
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased energy, more lateness to class, further reduced study efficiency
